data.long_description:
Step into luxury with this stunning 2-bedroom apartment located on the 24th floor of Boulevard Point, Downtown Dubai. Spanning 1,433.21 sq. ft., this elegantly furnished unit offers a seamless blend of style, comfort, and convenience — perfect for both end-users and investors.

-Fully Furnished 
-Direct Link to the Dubai Mall
-Very private / Corner unit
-360 Full views of Downtown, Boulevard, Address and partial Fountain
-Best layout
-Very spacious and filled with light
-Window in Bedroom
-Both Bedrooms have separate Bathrooms
-Powder Room

Building & Community Features:

-Direct Access to Dubai Mall via Link Bridge
-Infinity Pool & State-of-the-Art Gym
-Concierge & 24/7 Security Services
-Children's Play Area
-Covered Parking
-Walking Distance to Burj Khalifa & Dubai Opera
-Surrounded by World-Class Dining, Retail & Entertainment

Located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, Boulevard Point offers the ultimate urban lifestyle with unparalleled access to the city’s most iconic attractions. Whether you're seeking a vibrant city home or a high-yield investment, this property is an exceptional choice.
